evals.prompt: Explain how text insertion flows through the Novident Editor — from a keypress to the document change. What are the key components involved?
evals.expected_output: Traces: IME/keyboard → Transaction.insertText (delta compose map) → EditorState.apply → operations applied to Document → delta changes emitted → selection updated → undo recorded. Mentions transactionStream and that all mutations go through apply().

evals.prompt: Why doesn't spell check run while the user is typing, and how are misspelled words marked in the document?
evals.expected_output: Out-of-band analysis: SpellCheckService listens to delta changes, a global inactivity timer (debounce ~600ms) restarts on each change, on expiry pending nodes are re-analyzed entirely and proofState:'error' marks are injected into the delta directly via node.updateAttributes — never through transactions or emitChanges, so it can't loop.

evals.prompt: How does undo work in this editor? What makes a burst of typing become a single undo step?
evals.expected_output: HistoryItem collects operations + before/after selection; sealing is debounced (minHistoryItemDuration ~50ms) so a typing burst is one undo step; undo() inverts operations in reverse order and applies with recordUndo:false, recordRedo:true; FixedSizeStack (200) backs both stacks.
